changes.detail: same signature (self) -> str; 1 of 1 exercised inputs disagree

witness.old: raise: RuntimeError: Couldn't detect Bash version, shell completion is not supported.
witness.new:
ok: '_x_completion() {
    local IFS=$'\n'
    local response

    response=$(env COMP_WORDS="${COMP_WORDS[*]}" COMP_CWORD=$COMP_CWORD x=bash_complete $1)

    for completion in $response; do
        IFS=',' read type value <<< "$completion"

        if [[ $type == 'dir' ]]; then
            COMPREPLY=()
            compopt -o dirnames
        elif [[ $type == 'file' ]]; then
            COMPREPLY=()
            compopt -o default
        elif [[ $type == 'plain' ]]; then
            COMPREPLY+=($value)
        fi
    done

    return 0
}

_x_completion_setup() {
    complete -o nosort -F _x_completion x
}

_x_completion_setup;
'
